settings.heading: Cortex
settings.lede: Build the rails. Harvest the planet. Fill the rocket. Compact logistics strategy for classic x86 — assembly, a .COM file, bootable from floppy.
settings.story_heading: Earth’s last unaging generation is dying.
settings.story_text: You are Orbital Commander. Neurofung grows only on Kepler-486i. A full rocket could change the fate of humanity. Remote link: active.
settings.rules_sub: Build the machine that saves humanity.
